info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Tax Advisory API
info.description: The Corporate Tax Advisory API provides essential services for businesses seeking expert guidance on corporate tax matters. This API facilitates access to a range of tax advisory resources, helping clients navigate complex tax regulations, optimize their tax strategies, and ensure compliance. Typical consumers include corporate finance teams, tax professionals, and consultants who require up-to-date information and insights. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial decision-making processes and drive tax efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to access comprehensive information regarding corporate tax advisory services, including available options, features, and benefits tailored to their business needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding corporate tax advisory services. It should contain all necessary parameters and filters to specify the desired advisory details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested corporate tax advisory information.

GetCorporateTaxAdvisoryRequest.description: This schema represents the request body content for the corporate finance tax advisory operations in GET requests. It is currently a placeholder for string type data.

items.description: A list of corporate tax advisory records.

sort.description: Indicates the sort order for the advisory records.
